messages:
Maya: Quick UX check on the compact metrics list: two problems — legend text wraps and pushes the mini-chart down, and extreme spikes in the sparkline are clipped so rows look flat. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.example/ux/compact-list-01.png

Rohan: The clipping is misleading. Could we show a tiny indicator for out-of-bounds peaks instead of autoscaling each sparkline? Autoscale ruins cross-row comparisons.

Lena: I like an indicator. Proposal: a 1px tall vertical marker at the right edge when the real peak > preview max, with hover revealing peak value/time. Keep global scale for consistency.

Sam (Design): Legend wrap fixes: option 1 = single-line truncate + ellipsis + accessible tooltip; option 2 = move unit into a small badge. Prefer 1 for shipped quick fix.

Theo (Eng): Option 1 is quick (CSS text-overflow). We'll add a real tooltip element (not just title) so screen readers can access it. For marker, we'll render an SVG <line> overlay and attach aria-describedby to the popup.

Maya: Accessibility checklist: marker contrast >=3:1, tooltip reachable by keyboard, SR announces full series name + peak. No tab order shuffling.

accessibility-bot: reminder: include role="button" and keyboard handlers for the marker popup per a11y checklist.

Sam (Design): Draft tooltip copy: "Series: db write latency — peak 1.9s at 09:18 UTC — unit: p95 (ms)". Ellipsis SR hint: "press Enter for details".

Rohan: Also consider tiny axis unit ambiguity in compact rows — show unit only on expand, and expose unit via an icon tooltip in the row.

Maya: Decision: ship single-line truncation + accessible tooltip, add outlier marker + keyboard popup, defer per-row autoscale to v2. Action items: Sam 5 write a11y copy & spec; Theo 5 spike branch with SVG marker; Rohan 5 mock small screens. Target: demo by next Wed.

Theo (Eng): Starting spike PR, will link demo here when ready.

Maya: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
